disclaimer: Screening guidance based on AAOIFI-style principles. Not a fatwa. Confirm with a qualified Shariah scholar before acting.

riba.name: Riba (interest)
riba.why: A fixed or guaranteed return on a loan of money is riba and is prohibited.

maysir.name: Maysir (gambling)
maysir.why: Gaining or losing wealth purely by chance is maysir and is prohibited.

gharar.name: Gharar (excessive uncertainty)
gharar.why: Excessive uncertainty about price, subject matter or delivery invalidates a contract. Only excessive gharar is prohibited and scholars differ on the limit.

haram_sector.name: Prohibited sector
haram_sector.why: Trading in or earning from prohibited goods and services is not permitted.

disputed_sector.name: Disputed sector
disputed_sector.why: Scholars differ on this sector, so it needs a scholar's opinion rather than a fixed ruling.

financing.name: Murabaha (cost-plus sale)
financing.conditions: The bank buys the item and sells it to you at a fixed, disclosed mark-up. You pay in instalments.

financing.name: Ijarah (lease)
financing.conditions: The financier owns the asset and leases it to you for a known rent. Ownership may transfer at the end.

financing.name: Musharakah (joint venture)
financing.conditions: Partners put in capital and share profit by agreed ratio and loss by capital share.

financing.name: Mudarabah (investor capital)
financing.conditions: An investor funds the business and you manage it. Profit is shared by ratio and the investor bears financial loss.

financing.name: Salam (advance purchase)
financing.conditions: You are paid now for goods of a defined quantity and quality delivered on a fixed date.

financing.name: Istisna (made-to-order)
financing.conditions: The financier pays a manufacturer to build to your specification, with staged payments.

financing.name: Qard Hasan (benevolent loan)
financing.conditions: An interest-free loan where only the principal is repaid. Suited to small amounts.
